note: MT State Park at the confluence where the Jefferson, Madison and Gallatin form the Missouri, NE of Three Forks (3 mi off I-90); small campground plus a rental tipi, river access, Saturday-night speaker series. --Claude
summary: FWP page + ReserveAmerica: confirmed 17 sites to 60 ft, vault toilets and water, reservable on ReserveAmerica with the inherited 3-month window and 1-day cutoff; added no electric (every RA site 'Electric Hookup - no'), pull-throughs, flush toilets. Season (year-round) already manual and consistent. Fees left as recorded (FWP gives only the statewide range). fcfs some_sites left derived: FWP says all sites go first-come after the reservation period, not that some are always first-come. Note corrected ('mix electric/non-electric' is wrong) and trimmed.
